result.summary: 57-year-old woman underwent intra-abdominal lymph node excision for metastatic malignancy, complicated by vascular injury requiring patch-graft repair and arterial thrombosis. Intubation is documented on 12/28; ongoing ventilator need is not established by later records and requires confirmation for placement. Latest labs show anemia (hemoglobin 9.9 g/dL), INR 1.7, and improving liver enzyme elevations; no contact-isolation indication is supported.
result.contact_isolation_reason: No supporting infection or colonization documented; MRSA screen was negative.
tubes: Endotracheal tube documented 12/28; ongoing presence unconfirmed
